about: Word cues: each points at a syllable of a VO line (0 = its first; .5 = half-way through one) and gen-vo.mjs turns it into seconds on the measured audio. phrases = syllables per space-separated phrase of every line in vo-botnoi.txt, as spoken (เอกสาร 3, สรรพากร 3, ทวิ 2, ฟังก์ชัน 2, มูลค่า 2, ปฏิบัติ 3, ธุรกิจ 3, โปรแกรม 2, มาตรฐาน 3, ตลาด 2) — a pause on a phrase break anchors the count, and D:/TTS/scripts/make_vo.py --pick reads the totals for the pace of a take. Edit a line's text and its phrases here together.
